verdict.rationale: As physical hardware the CPU is inherently self-hosted, and AMD's GAIA AI stack built for Ryzen explicitly supports fully local, air-gapped deployment (local inference, RAG, agent framework, desktop UI) rather than requiring any cloud service, directly satisfying the self-hosting need for AI-native users. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of self-hosting GAIA on this exact chip, and more detail on deployment/setup steps.
